title: Verify: buildEffects unit tests with a fake effect context
summary: Test buildEffects ordering, depth and transition
acceptance_criteria: Create calls and effects layer depth are asserted
Transition call and handle destruction are asserted

steps.action: Make ctx with createEffect: vi.fn(() => ({destroy: vi.fn()})) and playTransition: vi.fn(); call buildEffects with validScene plus dust, ambientLight and fade(400); assert createEffect called twice with depth 400, playTransition called once with 400, returned length 2; with no effects assert length 0 and no calls; destroy all handles and assert each destroy called
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/buildEffects.test.ts
